description: Module 1: Dashboard - A /dashboard route with a splash/welcome area and a one-page summary showing key metrics (total nurses, active cohorts, placement rate, upcoming actions), cohort pipeline overview, recent activity feed, and quick-action cards.
steps: Create src/app/dashboard/page.tsx as a server component that calls getNurses(), getCohorts() from data.ts and renders the Dashboard client component

Create src/components/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx ('use client') - main dashboard layout with: welcome header (greeting + date), stat cards row, cohort pipeline summary, recent activity, and quick-action section

Create src/components/dashboard/StatCard.tsx - a metric card component showing: icon, label, value, optional trend indicator. Style with white card, rounded-xl, shadow-sm, icon in propela-purple-light circle.

Create src/components/dashboard/CohortPipelineChart.tsx - a horizontal stacked bar or summary showing nurses by pipeline stage across all active cohorts. Use recharts (already installed) or simple div-based progress bars.

Create src/components/dashboard/RecentActivity.tsx - a feed/list showing recent actions (nurses who advanced stages, OET results, placements). Use mock data derived from nurse lastContacted and pipeline stages.

Create src/components/dashboard/QuickActions.tsx - a row of clickable cards/buttons for common admin tasks: 'Review Applications', 'Chase OET Results', 'Send Reminders', 'Export Report'. Each links to relevant route or shows a badge count.
Update src/app/page.tsx to redirect to /dashboard instead of /nurses
Ensure the sidebar Dashboard link (/dashboard) correctly highlights when on that route
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
/dashboard route renders the full dashboard with welcome header, stat cards, pipeline chart, activity feed, and quick actions
Stat cards show: Total Nurses count, Active Cohorts count, Placement Rate percentage, Pending Actions count (derived from mock data)
Sidebar Dashboard link highlights when on /dashboard
Styling uses propela-purple brand colors and matches the admin-dashboard.jsx design reference style
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
Run pnpm lint and confirm zero errors or only warnings
